# Project Phoenix v45.0 — 12-Era Expanded Vanilla-Wwise Soundtrack Cues (Main Mod, 100% vanilla EU5 1.4.9 MusicPlayer_* events, 0 DLC, 0 custom .bnk). Generated by gen_v450_ai_and_audio_calibration.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# ==============================================================================
# Verified Vanilla-Wwise Playback Wrapper (Main Mod, 100% 0-DLC MusicPlayer_*)
# Respects oe_aud_muted, oe_wp26_mus_muted, oe_v45_aud_muted & global Rule #18 override.
# ==============================================================================

oe_v45_aud_play_verified_track = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			is_human = yes
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 3 }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud_muted }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp26_mus_muted }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_aud_muted }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud_cue_cd value = 1 months = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v45_aud_cd value = 1 months = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v45_aud_last_cue value = $cue_id$ }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_aud_play_count } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_aud_play_count value = 0 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_v45_aud_play_count add = 1 }
		post_audio_event = {
			persistent_object = music_manager
			event = $track$
		}
	}
}

# 10 Era-Weighted Vanilla-Wwise Cue Selectors (1337-1836 + 1444 Hesperian Odyssey)

	random_list = {

				track = MusicPlayer_01_Overture_I_Genesis
				cue_id = 1
			}
		}
		25 = {
			modifier = { factor = 1.3 at_war = yes }

# Country scope. Dispatches one era-weighted vanilla-Wwise soundtrack cue for 1337-1836 human realms.
oe_v45_aud_dispatch_era_cue = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			is_human = yes
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 3 }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud_muted }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp26_mus_muted }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_aud_muted }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud_cue_cd }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp26_mus_cd }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_aud_cd }
		}
		# Fourth Rome Hesperian Odyssey (1420-1554 exile / American Greek realm)
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1420
				current_year <= 1554
				OR = {
					has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
					has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
					has_variable = oe_ely_voyager
					AND = {
						capital ?= { continent = continent:america }
						culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
					}
				}
			}
			oe_v45_aud_cue_1444_hesperian_odyssey = yes
		}
		# 1337-1419 Late Medieval Era
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1337
				current_year <= 1419
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					capital ?= {
						OR = {
							sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
							sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
						}
					}
				}
				oe_v45_aud_cue_1337_east_asia = yes
			}
			else = {
				oe_v45_aud_cue_1337_euro_med = yes
			}
		}
		# 1420-1491 Early Renaissance Courts
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1420
				current_year <= 1491
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					capital ?= {
						OR = {
							sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
							sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
						}
					}
				}
				oe_v45_aud_cue_1337_east_asia = yes
			}
			else = {
				oe_v45_aud_cue_1444_renaissance_courts = yes
			}
		}
		# 1492-1554 Age of Discovery
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1492
				current_year <= 1554
			}
			oe_v45_aud_cue_1492_discovery_seas = yes
		}
		# 1555-1700 Global Silver & Reformation
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1555
				current_year <= 1700
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					capital ?= {
						OR = {
							sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
							sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
							sub_continent = sub_continent:middle_east
							sub_continent = sub_continent:central_asia
						}
					}
				}
				oe_v45_aud_cue_1555_global_silver_asia = yes
			}
			else = {
				oe_v45_aud_cue_1555_reformation_baroque = yes
			}
		}
		# 1701-1755 Enlightenment Equilibrium
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1701
				current_year <= 1755
			}
			oe_v45_aud_cue_1701_enlightenment = yes
		}
		# 1756-1836 Atlantic Revolutions & Industrial Dawn
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1756
				current_year <= 1836
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					capital ?= {
						OR = {
							sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
							sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
							sub_continent = sub_continent:middle_east
							sub_continent = sub_continent:west_africa
						}
					}
				}
				oe_v45_aud_cue_1756_asia_global = yes
			}
			else = {
				oe_v45_aud_cue_1756_atlantic_industrial = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
